domain: public debt markets / weekly Government of Ghana and Bank of Ghana bill auction outcomes (Ghana)
prediction_question: At the post-auction publication instant of a weekly Ghana Treasury/GOG tender (or Bank of Ghana bill tender), predict the next auction's marginal-rate direction and/or subscription coverage from the full published auction history. A useful prediction would support the same treasury/cash-management decision the weekly results exist for. The licence veto recorded below was established before any archive probing; no novelty claim is made in either direction.
prediction_time: Each auction's results-publication instant (results pages are dated, e.g. 'Results of GOG Tender 2031' Oct 30 2026; 'Results of Tender 886 Held on 4 November 2026' Nov 4 2026). Not further specified because the lead was closed at the licence gate.
target_definition: Direction of the next auction's accepted rate per tenor, and/or subscription coverage (bids tendered vs target amount). Label derivable from the published results pages. Not probed further: bare copyright veto.

sources.name: Bank of Ghana - weekly GOG T-Bill auction results archive
sources.api: No API; WordPress listing of per-tender results pages (Results of GOG Tender 2032 down through 2021 and earlier, observed 2026-11-07 via search-index snippets of the live pages). Weekly cadence.

sources.name: Bank of Ghana - weekly BOG Bill auction results archive
sources.api: No API; WordPress listing of per-tender results pages (Results of Tender 886 held on 4 November 2026 and earlier). Two tenders per week observed in the 2026-10/11 listing pattern.

license_evidence: Publisher instrument 1 (2026-11-07): every Bank of Ghana results page and site page carries the footer '© 2026 Bank of Ghana. All rights reserved.' - observed directly on the rendered Disclaimer page (curl) and in the search-index renderings of the auction-results pages.

Publisher instrument 2 (2026-11-07): https://www.bog.gov.gh/terms-conditions/ returns the site's 404 page ('Oops! That page can't be found') - no terms-of-use instrument exists at the conventional path.

Publisher instrument 3 (2026-11-07): https://www.bog.gov.gh/disclaimer/ exists and is an accuracy/non-liability disclaimer ('The information on this site is provided for general reference purposes only...'), with no reuse or redistribution grant.
Publisher instrument 4 (2026-11-07): https://www.bog.gov.gh/robots.txt returns nginx 404 - no machine-readable policy.
The BoG 'Database Portal' (linked as 'BoG Oracle Portal' quick link) is a query UI for economic series, not a bulk data channel; no licence statement is visible on the site surface for it.
split_strategy: Not reached (licence veto). For scale planning on any reopen: two weekly auction series (GOG T-bills tender numbering ~2021-2032 by 2026-10; BOG bills tender ~886 by 2026-11-04, implying a longer continuous series back to the BOG bill's introduction), i.e. plausibly several hundred to ~900 weekly outcomes per series; window counts were never computed.

measurements.channel_sweep_2026_11_07: Footer copyright observed on rendered pages; /terms-conditions/ HTTP 404 (site 404 page); /disclaimer/ 200 with accuracy-only text; /robots.txt nginx 404. Commands in notes.md.
measurements.archive_observation_2026_11_07: GOG results listing (via search-index renderings of the live pages, read 2026-11-07): weekly 'Results of GOG Tender N' pages, consecutive numbering observed Oct 2026 tenders 2026-2031, plus listing pages back through August 2026 and earlier-page links implying a longer archive. BOG results listing: tenders 880-886 Sept-Nov 2026, twice-weekly 'held on' dates. No per-tender fetch or parsing was done past the veto.

rejection_reason: Licence veto (class C, closed under the 2026-10-21 standing policy): bare copyright with all rights reserved asserted on every Bank of Ghana page, an accuracy-only disclaimer, a 404 terms page and no redistribution grant on any instrument. This is the third central-bank auction archive in this family closed on the identical posture (CBK Kenya 2026-10-30; Bank of Ghana today), which establishes the pattern rather than an isolated case: African central-bank auction data is task-shaped, unit-level and decision-relevant, and published under bare copyright. The archive was not scraped, parsed or counted; novelty was never reached and is NOT claimed in either direction.
review: Ghana's most task-shaped source found this tick (weekly unit-level auction outcomes, ongoing, dated, decision-relevant) killed at the licence gate before any archive work - the correct order. Future Ghana-focused sessions should read the BoG footer first; if a Ghana treasury-auction task is ever wanted, the blocker is the publisher's terms, not the data.
next_action: Closed 2026-11-07. Reopen ONLY if: (a) the Bank of Ghana states a licence or terms permitting redistribution of derived auction rows on its own instrument (re-check the footer, /disclaimer/, /terms-conditions/ and the BoG Oracle Portal; the 2026-11-07 channel list is in license_evidence); (b) the operator records an explicit candidate-specific risk acceptance per skills/dataset-discovery/references/licence-posture.md - one candidate, never extendable to sibling Ghanaian sources; or (c) the operator authorises a written licence enquiry (standing default: no unsolicited permission email).
